summary: ICON plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited non-consolidated non-statutory interim financial statements for the period ended September 30, 2026, signed by Chief Financial Officer Nigel Clerkin on September 9, 2026. The Irish foreign private issuer made no transactional announcement; the filing is a routine interim accounts disclosure under the 1934 Act, equivalent to a US quarterly financial-statement filing, with no deal, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. No risk-arbitrage angle applies; watch only for ordinary operating results and guidance implications.
